steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: Every job has its own project page. Here is how to read one.

steps.caption: The card
steps.narration: Find the job on the Pipeline board.

steps.caption: Open the project
steps.narration: Click its name to open the project.

steps.caption: Name, number, stage
steps.narration: At the top are the job's name, its number and its stage.

steps.caption: Revised contract
steps.narration: Revised contract is the contract with the change orders in it.

steps.caption: Budget
steps.narration: Budget is what you plan to spend.

steps.caption: Committed
steps.narration: Committed is the purchase orders and subcontracts you have placed.

steps.caption: Actual cost
steps.narration: Actual cost is the bills and labor posted so far.

steps.caption: Gross profit
steps.narration: Gross profit is the revised contract minus the actual cost. The margin is beside it.

steps.caption: Tabs
steps.narration: Below, each tab is one part of the job.

steps.caption: Punch list
steps.narration: Punch list is what is left to finish.

steps.caption: Daily logs
steps.narration: Daily logs record each day's work.

steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: JobCam holds the photos from this job.

steps.caption: Back to the board
steps.narration: Pipeline, at the top of the page, takes you back to the board.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: You'll find Pipeline in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read a project page | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of a project page in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a job from the Pipeline and read its revised contract, budget, committed and actual cost, gross profit and margin, then look at the tabs under them.
